Our Story

A Journey of Innovation and Collaboration

Siva's Entrepreneurial Journey
Siva, a seasoned entrepreneur, founded PowerUpCloud in 2015 and successfully sold it
to Larsen & Toubro Infotech (LTI) in 2019. Upon completion of his engagement with LTI
in 2022, he identified the transformative potential of AI in the field of data analysis.


The Birth of Lyzr
Inspired by ChatGPT, Siva envisioned a product where users could upload CSV or Excel
files and ask questions, receiving insights and recommendations in return. As he
discussed this idea with potential customers, Siva realized the paramount importance of
data privacy. Additionally, he found the existing platform, LangChain, inadequate for his
vision. This led to the birth of Lyzr in April 2023, derived from the word “analyzer.”
Lyzr was initially focused on creating an AI product for data analysis but soon pivoted to
developing an agent framework by October 2023.
An agent framework, as Siva saw it, was a platform to build AI agents capable of
autonomously performing tasks based on given inputs. The rise of chat-based agents
during late 2023 solidified this direction.
Lyzr began with chat agents and knowledge search agents, eventually expanding into
workflow automation. Key innovations include the AI SDR (Sales Development
Representative) for sales, Skott for marketing automation, and Diane, an HR-specific
agent, each designed to optimize and streamline essential business functions.


Building the Team
Siva reunited with Anirudh, a long-time friend and colleague, who brought technical
expertise and shared vision. Jimmy, another friend, joined as CTO with his strong
technical background.

Together, the team of 50+ operates across the US and India, creating innovative AI
solutions. Lyzr's mission is to redefine what's possible through the power of AI agents.
United by a common goal and diverse expertise, team Lyzr continues to push the
boundaries of AI, creating innovative solutions that redefine what’s possible.



                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 5
Technological Advancements
Lyzr's development has been closely tied to advancements in AI technology. The
emergence of large language models like ChatGPT has played a pivotal role in enabling
Lyzr to create powerful and versatile AI agents. By leveraging these models, Lyzr can
provide natural language understanding, generate human-like text, and complete
complex tasks.

Product Evolution
Lyzr's product has evolved from its initial focus on data analysis to a broader platform
capable of automating various tasks. The company's agent framework allows for the
creation of customized AI agents that can be tailored to specific needs and industries.
This flexibility has enabled Lyzr to expand its offerings and target a wider range of
customers.

Impact on Industries
Lyzr's technology has the potential to transform a wide range of industries. In the sales
domain, Lyzr's AI SDR can automate lead generation and qualification tasks, freeing up
sales teams to focus on high-value activities. In customer service, Lyzr's AI agents can
provide 24/7 support and handle routine inquiries, improving customer satisfaction.
Additionally, Lyzr's technology can be applied to areas such as marketing, finance, and
operations to streamline processes and drive efficiency.


Future Outlook
As AI technology continues to advance, Lyzr is well-positioned to capitalize on emerging
opportunities. The company's focus on innovation and adaptability will be crucial in
ensuring its long-term success. Lyzr's future may include exploring new applications for
its technology, expanding into international markets, and forming strategic partnerships
with other companies.


Lyzr's journey from a data analysis tool to a versatile AI platform is a testament to the
power of innovation and the potential of AI to revolutionize industries. By leveraging
cutting-edge technology and building a strong team, Lyzr is poised to become a leader in
the AI space.

1. Personal Standards & Code of Conduct




At Lyzr, we believe in upholding a positive and professional workplace environment
where everyone thrives. As part of the team, we encourage you to embody
professionalism, integrity, and cooperation in your interactions with colleagues,
customers, business contacts, and the wider community.
We expect employees to approach their work with dedication, sincerity, and honesty.
Additionally, safeguarding the company's assets, information, and intellectual property is
vital. This includes adhering to confidentiality, non-compete, and non-solicitation
policies. Employees transitioning out of Lyzr are kindly reminded not to engage in
employee poaching.


All tasks and responsibilities assigned by your Reporting Manager or the Management
should be carried out diligently. In cases of any concerns or challenges, please feel free
to communicate openly with your manager for support and guidance.
While employed at Lyzr, employees are requested to focus their efforts on company
activities. If you wish to pursue external ventures or side projects, prior written approval
from management is required to ensure alignment with company policies.

                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  14
2. Working Hours

All full-time employees are eligible for flexible work arrangements, unless specific job
requirements necessitate fixed working hours.




Guidelines:
A. Core Hours
Employees are expected to be available during core hours, typically from 2 PM to 7 PM
IST, Monday to Friday for team collaboration and meetings. Outside of these hours,
employees may adjust their start and end times based on personal needs, ensuring an
8-hour workday (excluding breaks) is completed.

B. Remote Work Flexibility
Employees may choose to work remotely, as per team and role requirements. Managers
should approve remote work arrangements to ensure team collaboration is maintained.




                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                15
C. Availability
Employees should keep calendars updated with working hours to facilitate collaboration
and scheduling.


D. Approval Process
Any flexible work schedule that deviates significantly from standard hours should be
discussed and approved by the reporting manager.

E. Exceptions and Adjustments
In cases of project deadlines or team needs, managers may request adherence to
specific hours.

F. Accountability and Performance
Flexible work is built on trust. Employees are expected to meet performance and project
deadlines regardless of chosen work hours.


While timesheets are not mandatory for all employees, in cases of performance or
availability concerns, employees may be required to submit timesheets for performance
tracking.


All employees will receive notification alerts for any changes in work timings, asset
allocation, birthdays, work anniversary and upcoming holiday from the HRMS.

Employees are encouraged to regularly go through the HRMS to keep themselves
updated of the same.

3. Remote Working
Working remotely at Lyzr requires maintaining productivity and communication
standards consistent with office-based work.




Key Expectations
   Ensure a suitable home workspace with stable internet. Frequent connectivity
   issues may be considered as unavailability.
   Stay accessible via phone, email, and Slack during work hours.
   Video calls on Google Meet or Zoom require the video to be ON for all meetings.
   Respond to calls or messages from Leadership, HR, or your Reporting Manager
   within 12 working hours or by the next working day after a weekend/holiday.

Hybrid Work Arrangement
Lyzr offers a hybrid working model, combining office and remote work to suit team needs
and individual preferences.
   Specific schedules will be discussed with your manager based on role and business
   requirements.
   While working remotely, all employees must follow Lyzr's remote work policies.
   At Lyzr, we aim to create a supportive and flexible work environment that balances
   personal needs with company goals. Should you have any questions or require

4. Night shift & weekend policy




Purpose & Scope
This policy establishes the framework under which Lyzr AI India Private Limited ("Lyzr" /
"the Company") engages eligible employees to perform work during night hours or on
weekends when such work is required by genuine business or project needs.


The objectives of this policy are to:

    Recognize and fairly compensate employees for the personal and physical sacrifice
    involved in working night hours or weekends;
    Establish a structured, transparent, and consistent allowance framework that scales
    with compensation level.
    Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws
    Set out specific safeguards for women employees in line with statutory
    requirements; and
    Define approval, tracking, and payout mechanisms applicable to all eligible
    engagements.




                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              19
Applicability
This policy applies to the Following Eligible teams: Program Management, Applied AI,
and India Customer Success Management.

    Eligible roles: Individual contributors and people managers up to the level of Project
    Manager / Solution Architect.
    Work location: All employees in scope are to work remotely from their declared
    residential address in India.


Exclusions
This policy does not apply to:

    CXOs, Vice Presidents, and Directors;
    Product and Platform engineering teams;
    Internal initiatives, hackathons, or self-directed work performed outside business
    hours without project sponsor approval.



Definitions

  Policy Name                Definition


                             Any continuous block of work commencing at or after 11:00 pm IST
  Night Shift                and extending into the early morning hours, 7:00 am of the following
                             day.


                             Work performed on a Saturday or Sunday, where Saturday/Sunday is
  Weekend Work

                             An employee in an eligible team and role (per Section 1.1) who has
                             provided prior written consent and whose night shift/weekend work
  Eligible Employee

                             designate).


                             The employee is designated as the project lead and approver for work
  Project Manager
                             performed under a specific client engagement or internal project.

  Approving Authority
                             approval before any allowance is paid.

Eligibility & Approval
Pre-Conditions
An employee is eligible for night shift or weekend allowance only if all of the following
conditions are met:

      The employee belongs to an eligible team and role per Section 1.1;
      The employee has signed the Night Shift Consent Undertaking (Annexure A) and
      submitted it to People Operations.
      The work is driven by a documented business/project need (e.g., client SLAs across
      time zones, production support, scheduled deployment windows, time-bound
      deliverables);
      Pre-approval has been obtained from the Project Manager.
      Final approval has been obtained from the COO or designee prior to payroll
      processing.

Allowance Structure
Slab-Based Allowance
Allowance is paid as a flat amount per qualifying shift, scaled to the employee's annual
CTC. The slabs are:


                                                                   Per Full Shift (4 hours or
  Annual CTC                      Per Half-Shift (4 hours)
                                                                   more)


  Up to ₹10,00,000                ₹1,000                           ₹2,000


  ₹10,00,001 – ₹20,00,000         ₹1,500                           ₹3,000


  Above ₹20,00,000                ₹2,000                           ₹4,000


Note: The same slab structure applies to both night shifts and weekend work. Half-shift
and full-shift definitions apply equally to weekend days based on actual hours worked.




                                  Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                        22
Shift Buckets
To keep tracking and payout simple in Phase 1, only two buckets are recognized:


  Bucket       Definition (Night Shift)        Definition (Weekend Work)      Payout



               Worked at least 4 hours, with
                                               Worked at least 4 hours on a   Half allowance
  Half-shift   the work commencing at or
                                               Saturday or Sunday             per slab
               after 11:00 pm IST


               Worked 8 hours or more, with
                                               Worked 8 hours or more on a    Full allowance
  Full-shift   the work commencing at or
                                               Saturday or Sunday             per slab
               after 11:00 pm IST




Treatment as Allowance, Not Salary
The Night Shift Allowance and Weekend Work Allowance are non-salary cash
payments processed through payroll under separate allowance heads. They are:
   Paid in addition to the employee's fixed monthly salary;
   Not part of cost-to-company (CTC) and not factored into gratuity, leave encashment,
   or bonus calculations;
   Subject to applicable income tax in the hands of the employee. (See Section 4.6 - Tax
   Treatment.)



Tax Treatment
The allowance will be paid through the monthly payroll under the head "Night Shift
Allowance" / "Weekend Work Allowance". The exact tax treatment (taxable / partially
exempt) will be confirmed by the Finance team prior to rollout, in consultation with
payroll counsel. Until that confirmation is recorded:
    Employees should treat the full allowance as taxable income.
    TDS will be deducted as applicable based on the employee's tax declarations.
    People Ops will issue an updated note once the final position is confirmed.




                                   Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              23
Frequency Guidelines (Phase 1)
To prevent overuse and protect employee well-being, the following soft caps apply:
    No more than 8 night shifts per employee per calendar month, save in exceptional,
    documented circumstances approved by the COO;
    No more than 6 weekend days per employee per calendar quarter, save in
    exceptional circumstances;
    People Ops will flag any employee approaching these limits for a well-being check-
    in.


Specific Safeguards for Women Employees
In compliance with applicable laws, , the following additional safeguards apply to women
employees engaging in night shift work, including in the remote-work context:

Consent - Mandatory and Written
   No woman employee shall be deployed on a night shift without her prior, voluntary,
   written consent;
   Consent shall be obtained in the form set out in Annexure A and may be withdrawn at
   any time on a prospective basis without consequence.
   Consent is project-agnostic but must be reconfirmed annually.

Maternity Protection
   No woman employee shall be required or permitted to work night shifts during any
   period in which she is entitled to maternity benefits under the Code on Social
   Security, 2020.
   Pregnant employees and employees within 6 months of return from maternity leave
   are excluded from night shift eligibility unless they expressly request inclusion in
   writing, supported by medical clearance.

Remote-Work Specific Safeguards
For Lyzr's fully remote workforce, the spirit of these requirements is preserved through
the following adapted measures:
   Emergency contacts: A dedicated 24x7 People Ops emergency contact number
   and a designated POSH Internal Committee contact will be maintained and
   circulated to all women employees engaging in night work.
   Wellness check-ins: People Ops will conduct a quarterly 1:1 wellness check-in with
   each woman employee on night shift rotation.
   Buddy system: When two or more women employees are working the same night
   shift on a project, the team is encouraged to maintain a virtual buddy/check-in
   system.

                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               24
   Routing of work: Project managers will, as far as practicable, avoid scheduling a
   sole woman employee on isolated late-night shifts; rotation schedules will aim to
   ensure parallel coverage.
   POSH compliance: All provisions of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace
   (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 apply fully, including for
   virtual/remote interactions during night hours.
   Privacy of personal data: Personal contact details, addresses, and home location
   data of women employees shall not be disclosed to clients, vendors, or any
   unauthorized parties.


Rotation
Night shift work for women employees shall be organized on a rotational basis where
multiple eligible employees are available, in line with the rotation principle under the
applicable laws.



Tracking, Approval, and Payout
Tracking Mechanism
   Phase 1 (immediate): A People Ops-maintained shared tracker (Excel / Google
   Sheets) where Project Managers log approved night/weekend shifts;
   • Phase 2 (target Q2 rollout): Native logging within Cortex, including project tagging,
   shift-type selection, and PM approval workflow.

Required Tracking Fields
   Employee Name and Employee ID
   Date of shift
   Shift type (Night / Weekend)
   Start and end times (IST)
   Total hours worked
   Project/engagement name and task description
   Project Manager approval (Yes / No / Date)
   COO approval (Yes / No / Date)
   Allowance bucket (Half / Full)
   Slab applicable
   Allowance amount




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 25
Payroll Cycle
   Allowance is paid in the calendar month following the month in which the shift was
   worked.
   People Ops requires the consolidated, COO-approved list at least 3 working days
   before the payroll cut-off date.
   Late submissions will be processed in the subsequent month's payroll.

Audit and Records
   All night shift and weekend work records will be retained for a minimum of 3 financial
   years.
   Records are subject to internal audit and may be requested by labor authorities upon
   a valid request.
   Consent forms will be retained for the duration of the employee's service plus 3
   years post-separation.



Misuse, Disputes & Enforcement
Misuse
Logging false or unapproved shifts, claiming allowance for non-business work, or any
attempt to manipulate the tracking system will be treated as a breach of the Code of
Conduct and may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.
Disputes
Any disputes regarding allowance eligibility, slab applicability, or payout calculation
should be raised with People Ops within 30 days of the relevant payroll. Disputes
unresolved at the People Ops level may be escalated to the COO.

Policy Review
This is a Phase 1 policy. People Ops will review the policy after the first full quarter of
operation, taking into account:
   Volume and pattern of usage;
   Employee feedback;
   Edge cases encountered;
   Changes in applicable law;
   Tax treatment confirmation.
Material changes will be communicated in writing with at least 15 days' notice.



  For more details and understanding the policy, please reach out to your manager.

5. Dress Code
Purpose
To establish guidelines for appropriate attire in the workplace, promoting
professionalism and a positive work environment. This policy applies to all meetings
involving clients, customers, and team members.




General Guidelines
   Professional Appearance: employees are expected to maintain a professional
   appearance that reflects the company's image.
   Comfort and Modesty: Attire should be comfortable, clean, and modest.
   Avoid Extremes: Avoid excessively revealing, casual, or provocative clothing.



                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                            27
Specific Guidelines
a. Tops
   Shirts, T-shirts, collared or polo shirts
   Avoid tank tops

b. Bottoms
   Pants, jeans, skirts, or dresses
   Avoid shorts or sweatpants

c. Footwear
   Closed-toe shoes or sneakers
   Avoid flip-flops
   Men to avoid sandals

d. Accessories
   Keep accessories minimal and professional.
   Avoid excessive jewellery or piercings.


Exceptions
  Casual Fridays: The company may designate certain days as "Casual Fridays,"
  allowing for more relaxed attire. However, the dress code should still be appropriate
  for a professional environment.
  Special Events: For special events or client meetings, a more formal dress code may
  be required.


Enforcement
  Violations of the dress code will be addressed on a case-by-case basis.
  Employees who consistently violate the dress code may be subject to disciplinary
  action.

6. Background Verification




All employees are subject to background verification at the time of joining.

The verification will include authentication of any factual or historical information
provided by the employee, related to past and present data such as reference details,
previous employment details, educational credentials, and criminal records, etc.


Employees will be required to provide written consent for background checks prior to
their employment.


The company will obtain consent in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. All
employees are expected to cooperate with the HR department in submitting all the
documents required for verification.


The company may engage a background verification company to carry out such
verification.


The employee’s appointment shall be subject to the sole discretion of the Company. Any
discrepancies or inconsistencies found during the background check process will be
investigated and addressed.


Employment of an employee could be liable to termination if the said particulars are
unsatisfactory to the Company after employment has commenced.


All background check records will be retained for a specified period in accordance with
applicable laws and regulations.

                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                             29
7. Asset Policy
At Lyzr, we trust you with essential tools to help you excel in your role.




To ensure their safety and proper use, here are some straightforward guidelines:


Safeguarding Company Assets
During your employment, you’re responsible for taking care of company assets like
laptops, phones, data, files, and other equipment provided to you.


Avoid handing over these assets to anyone unauthorized. If needed, return them only to
an authorized person designated by the company.




                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                           30
Returning Assets
All company assets should be returned promptly when requested or at the time of your
separation, ideally on or before your last working day.


Using Company Assets
   Use company assets solely for work-related purposes. Activities like downloading,
   browsing, or sharing non-work-related content are prohibited.
   Keep all documents and files secure, and don’t make copies or share them without
   prior approval from management.


Physical Security of Assets
   Lock your laptop or other devices with a password when not in use.
   Store them securely in a locked cabinet or desk, and never leave them unattended in
   public spaces or vehicles.
   When traveling, avoid packing devices in checked luggage and secure them in a
   hotel safe or locked suitcase when not in use.


Maintenance and Repairs
   Report any damage or maintenance issues to the IT Manager immediately via official
   email.
   Only Lyzr is authorized to handle repairs or maintenance of company-provided
   assets.


Regular Audits
The company may audit or recall assets periodically for maintenance or compliance
checks.

By adhering to these practices, you help us maintain a secure and efficient work
environment. If you have any questions about these guidelines, feel free to reach out to
IT or HR for assistance.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               31
8. Compensation & Deductions
Compensation paid to an employee is subject to statutory deductions, including applicable
taxes and any other deductions specified below.




The employee's compensation will be paid on a monthly basis and credited to their
designated bank account within the first working day of the following month for which the
salary is due. While the Company will make every effort to ensure timely payment, the
employee will not be entitled to interest or penalties in the event of delayed payments.


In the case of employment termination, the Company reserves the right to deduct any
outstanding amounts due from the employee from their total compensation payable.
These deductions may include, but are not limited to:

   Any debt or advance the employee owes to the Company.
   Deductions related to leave or holidays taken beyond the employee’s entitlement at
   the time of termination.
   Any deductions related to expenses incurred by the Company or for the cost of
   repairing damage to the Company’s property or assets caused by the employee.
   Any deductions related to the terms and conditions of employee training or
   relocation.

                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                            32
9. Trainings
At Lyzr, we believe in investing in your professional growth through comprehensive
training programs that help you enhance your skills and contribute to both your success
and the company’s.




Your Role in Training
Training programs are designed to benefit you and align with your career goals. We
encourage full participation and commitment during these sessions.


Travel for Training
Some training programs may involve travel, either within India or abroad. Your
willingness to participate in these opportunities helps us equip you with the best tools
and knowledge.

We strive to make every training opportunity valuable and enriching. If you have
questions about the training process or agreements, feel free to connect with HR or your
manager.

                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                33
10. Holidays & Leaves




Purpose
To provide comprehensive guidelines to employees on holidays, and leaves, with the
intent of facilitating better work-life balance, providing time for vacation & to attend to
other critical personal emergencies and vital life events.


Scope
This policy is applicable to all regular on-roll employees.


Policy Statement
Lyzr follows a calendar year cycle for holidays, extended weekends and a leaves
administration. Employees who are deployed for a specific customer will follow the
customer’s leave calendar.




                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                34
List of Holidays & Leaves

 Company Holiday                          12 days

 Casual Leave (CL)                        12 days

 Earned Leave (EL)                        1 day for every 20 days worked

 Sick Leave (SL)                          12 days

 Menstrual Leave (Applicable only
                                          1 day per month during menstrual cycle
 to the employees of Karnataka)

 Mental Well Being Leave                  4 days (1 in each Quarter)


 Bereavement Leave                        5 days


                                          26 continuous weeks of which not more
 Maternity Leave
                                          than 8 weeks would precede the delivery.

 Paternity Leave                          5 days

 Sabbatical Leave                         Up to 3 months

 Wedding leave                            5 days



Company Holidays
  Lyzr observes 12 working days as holidays for national holidays and festivals.
  Among these, 9 holidays are mandatory for all employees, while the remaining 3 can
  be selected from a floating holiday list based on location or local festivals.
  The holiday list may vary by location, aligning with local customs and holidays.
  The holiday list is available for viewing on the HRMS.
  In the case of the organization declaring any unplanned holidays due to unavoidable
  circumstances then employees are required to work on a weekend to compensate
  for the lost working day.



                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                            35
Casual Leave
  Casual Leaves are planned leaves and are generally meant to be used to address
  short-term, unexpected personal needs or emergencies or other personal needs.
  In year 1 of service, CL entitlement would be prorated based on the Date of Joining.
  In the month of joining, if the joining date is on or before the 15th of the month, then
  the employee would be eligible for 1 day CL for that month and if the joining date is
  post 15th of the month, then the employee will be eligible for 0.5 days of earned
  casual leave credit for that particular month.
  Increase in entitlement: Upon completion of 2 years of service, the entitlement would
  increase to 14 days. The credit of this increased entitlement would be spread over
  the subsequent quarters.
  Credit & Usage: CL shall be credited at the beginning of every calendar month. If an
  employee goes on “Leave Without Pay” (LWP), the LWP period is excluded while
  calculating the accumulation of CL for the month.
  Planning Leave: CL exceeding 2 days at a stretch must be planned ahead with the
  reporting manager. Planning may require informing all concerned.
  As a guideline, CL should be planned and applied as under:

  3-4 days CL: 15 days in advance,
  5-10 days CL: 30 days in advance,
  More than 10 CL: 2 months in advance.
  Accumulation of Leave: CL will lapse at the end of each calendar year and cannot be
  carried forward to the next year


Earned Leave (EL)
  These leaves are planned earned leaves and are generally meant to be used for
  rejuvenation, vacation, or reasons which need employees to stay away from work
  for longer durations.
  Entitlement: Employees are entitled to one leave for every 20 days that he has
  worked in a calendar year.
  In year 1 of service, EL entitlement would be prorated based on the Date of Joining of
  the employee.
  Credit & Usage: EL shall be credited at the beginning of every calendar month. If an
  employee goes on “Leave Without Pay” (LWP), the LWP period is excluded while
  calculating the accumulation of EL for the month.
  Planning Leave: EL exceeding 2 days at a stretch must be planned ahead with the
  reporting manager. Planning may require informing all concerned.



                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  36
  As a guideline, EL should be planned and applied as under:
  3-4 days EL: 15 days in advance,
  5-10 days EL: 30 days in advance,
  More than 10 EL: 2 months in advance.

  Accumulation of Leave: Earned leave that is not utilized within the calendar year can
  be carried forward to the next year, subject to a maximum of 30 days
  Leave Encashment: If an employee is discharged or dismissed from service during
  the course of the year he shall be entitled to leave with wages at the applicable rates.
  Encashment amount = (Monthly Gross salary/30) * (Number of days to be en-
  cashed).



Sick Leave (SL)
  Sick leaves include planned or unplanned leaves to meet personal exigencies such
  as sickness or any other reasonable cause related to medical needs.
  Entitlement: An employee can avail SL for a maximum of 12 working days in a
  financial calendar year. For new employees, SL eligibility would be prorated from the
  date of joining.
  Credit & Usage: SL is credited at the beginning of the year or on the date of joining,
  whichever is earlier.
  A maximum of 2 consecutive days can be availed as SL. However, for employees
  having to take more than 2 days’ time off for sickness, it is mandatory to submit a
  valid medical certificate/report issued by a registered medical practitioner to the
  reporting manager/ HR immediately on the date of return from leave. Failing which,
  the dates of leave shall be converted to LOP (Loss of Pay).
  Clubbing with Other Leaves: Only the leaves taken for sickness may be clubbed with
  EL, in the event an employee exhausts his/her Sick Leave. Where medical treatment
  is planned, it is essential for the employee to inform the manager, seek approval and
  intimate the HR team for recording such leave.
  Planning Leave: In case of unplanned leave for sickness, an employee should
  intimate the manager/HR before the business hours on the day of availing leave. If
  the employee is not in a position to inform the manager, then the employee should
  inform through a kith or kin.
  Accumulation of Leave: Unutilized SL would lapse at the year-end and can’t be
  carried forward.
  Encashment: If an employee entitled to any SL is discharged or dismissed from
  service when he is sick or suffering from the result of an accident, the employee is
  entitled to encash the unavailed SL.


                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  37
Menstrual Leave (Applicable only to the employees
of Karnataka):
  Every permanent, contractual, or outsourced woman employee between the age of
  18 to 52 years, shall be provided by the company with one (1) day of paid leave per
  month during the menstrual cycle, amounting to a total of 12 paid menstrual leave
  days in a year.
  Such employees must use the menstrual leave for each month within the same
  month and menstrual leave cannot be carried forward to the next month.
  Such employees are not required to provide any medical certificate in order to avail
  themselves of one day of menstrual leave each month.


Mental-Wellbeing Leave (MWL)
  Mental-Wellbeing leaves are unplanned leaves that help employees to rest and
  recover from any type of psychological stress.
  Entitlement: employees are entitled to 4 working days of Mental-Wellbeing Leave in
  a calendar year. Which is divided into 1 working day in each quarter.
  Credit & Usage: MWL is credited at the beginning of each quarter of the year.
  Planning Leave: An employee should intimate the manager/HR at least at the start of
  the business hours.
  Clubbing with other leaves: It cannot be clubbed with EL or SL.
  Leaves during Internship: All interns can take leave only during sickness or any other
  emergency. Take an email approval from the manager/HR to apply to leave. Leave
  beyond SL & MWL will be considered to be LOP.


Sabbatical Leave
  A sabbatical leave is a voluntary extended period of time off granted to employees to
  pursue personal, professional, or academic interests, or to address personal or
  family needs.
  Eligibility: Regular full-time employees who have completed a minimum of 3 years of
  continuous service with the company are eligible to apply for sabbatical leave.
  Duration of Sabbatical Leave: Employees may apply for a sabbatical leave of up to 3
  months. Sabbatical leave must be taken as a continuous period.




                            Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 38
  Application Process: employees interested in taking a sabbatical leave must submit
  a written application to their immediate supervisor and HR department at least 2
  months or 1 month before the project end date in advance of the requested start
  date. The application should include the purpose of the sabbatical leave, the
  proposed activities or plans during the leave, and any expected benefits to the
  employee and the organization. The immediate supervisor will review the
  application and make a recommendation to the HR department. The HR department
  will assess the employee's eligibility, evaluate the impact on the team and
  organization, and make a final decision. The employee will be notified of the decision
  in writing within 2-3 weeks of submitting the application.
  Approval and Conditions: Sabbatical leave is subject to approval based on business
  needs, staffing requirements, and the employee's performance and eligibility. The
  company reserves the right to deny or postpone sabbatical leave requests if they
  would significantly disrupt operations or create an undue burden on the team or
  organization. If approved, the employee and HR department will establish a written
  agreement outlining the terms and conditions of the sabbatical leave, including
  expectations for communication, reintegration, and return-to- work arrangements.
  During the sabbatical leave, the employee will be considered on an unpaid leave of
  absence, and benefits such as health insurance and retirement contributions may be
  affected.
  Reintegration and Return-to-Work: Return to work of the employee will be decided
  by the line manager and HR department. This is to ensure whether the employee still
  serves a purpose to the company/project or not. Prior to the end of the sabbatical
  leave, the employee will be required to attend a reintegration meeting with their
  supervisor and HR representative. The purpose of the reintegration meeting is to
  discuss the employee's return-to-work plan, any updates or changes in the role or
  responsibilities, and to facilitate a smooth transition back into the workplace.
  Companies have complete authority to dismiss the employee’s return to work with
  valid reason.


Maternity Leave
  Entitlement: The maximum period for which any woman employee shall be entitled
  to maternity leave benefits, shall be twenty-six (26) continuous weeks, of which not
  more than eight (8) weeks shall precede the date of her expected delivery. The
  maximum period for which any woman employee, having two or more surviving
  children, shall be entitled to maternity leave benefits, shall be twelve (12) continuous
  weeks, of which not more than six (6) weeks shall precede the date of her expected
  delivery.


                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  39
  Credit & Usage: Maternity Leave is provided only if the employee has worked in the
  company for a period of not less than 80 days in the twelve months immediately
  preceding the date of her expected delivery.
  The Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 entitles employees who are ill on account of their
  pregnancy or have delivered prematurely, to a maximum period of one month in
  addition to maternity leave.
  A woman employee who legally adopts a child below the age prescribed under
  applicable law or becomes a commissioning mother through surrogacy shall be
  entitled to twelve (12) weeks of leave, commencing from the date on which the child
  is handed over to her.
  A woman employee undergoing a tubectomy operation shall be entitled to two (2)
  weeks of leave from the date of the operation.
  A woman employee who suffers a miscarriage or undergoes medical termination of
  pregnancy, including procedures permitted under applicable law, shall be entitled to
  six (6) weeks of leave, immediately following the date of miscarriage or termination
  of pregnancy, as the case may be.
  Planning Leave: Maternity leave has to be applied a minimum one month in advance
  of going on such leave. Maternity leave shall apply from the date of delivery even if
  the employee has proceeded on any other kind of leave prior to the date of delivery.
  Subject to the nature of the work, a woman employee may be permitted to work from
  home after availing maternity benefits, for a mutually agreed period and on such
  terms and conditions as may be decided between the Company and the employee.
  Clubbing with other leaves: It can be clubbed with EL, if desired.


Wedding Leave
  Eligibility: Maximum 5 days may be availed by any employee on the occasion of their
  wedding.
  Planning Leave: The leave must be taken at a stretch and applied before 15 days of
  the wedding.


Paternity Leave
  Eligibility: Maximum 5 days may be availed by male employees on occasion of
  Childbirth. To be eligible the employee should have worked for more than 160 days
  in the 12 months immediately prior to the date of delivery.
  Credit & Usage: The leave must be taken at a stretch and within 1 month of the birth
  of the child.
  Casual leave can be suffixed or prefixed to a paternity leave. This has to be
  communicated to the manager and be approved at least a month before availing it.


                            Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                40
Bereavement Leave
  Eligibility: In case of the unfortunate event of the demise of an immediate family
  member, an employee would be eligible for 5 working days of paid leave. For the
  purpose of this policy, immediate family is defined as parents, parents-in-law,
  brother, sister, spouse and children.
  Credit & Usage: This leave should be taken at a stretch and within 1 week of the
  incident. A death certificate needs to be submitted for approval. Failure of
  submission will be a LOP.



Compensatory Off
  Eligibility: Any employee required to work on a holiday (on Company’s request) for
  normal office working hours can claim a compensatory off in lieu of the holiday
  worked, on a suitable date agreed by both, the employee and the concerned
  reporting manager.
  Credit & Usage: The credit request for Compensatory off should be made within 7
  days of the extra day of work. The compensatory off should be utilized within 30 days
  of the leave credit date and would lapse thereafter.



Loss Of Pay (LOP)
  Eligibility: Employees may seek leave without pay in circumstances where there is
  no leave balance in the employee’s leave account. Approval of such leaves is
  subject to the facts and circumstances, presented along with authenticated proofs
  for each case and is purely at the discretion of the Management. Such leaves shall
  be granted for a maximum period of one week.
  Extension of loss of pay will be validated at the end of the term granted and further
  approval is purely at the discretion of the Management.
  Credit & Usage: An employee shall not proceed on Leave without Pay, without the
  leave being duly approved in the system. Otherwise, it shall be treated as an
  unauthorized absence. During LOP, the Cash equivalent of the number of days
  availed is deducted from the employee’s salary & any repayment terms for any
  company loans or premium of Medical Insurance being availed by the employee will
  continue as predetermined and the employee will remit the corresponding amount
  respectively to the Company directly.




                            Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                41
Leave while on Part-Time Employment/Internship
   Eligibility of Casual Leave & Sick will be prorated for an employee on a part-time
   work week and will be proportionate to the reduced hours of work.
   Leaves for interns will be allotted only after they complete their internship and are
   converted to full-time employees. Leaves taken before the end of the internship
   period will be considered under LOP.




Leave during Notice Period
Leave during the notice period can be sanctioned only for medical exigencies or other
emergency situations. In such cases of exigency or emergency, the manager may
sanction EL or SL only, against Medical Certificate. The company reserves the right to
increase the days of the Notice Period by the number of days an employee has availed
leaves during Notice Period.




Unauthorized Absence
   Employees are requested to avoid taking unplanned Leave. If an employee is taking
   an unplanned leave due to unavoidable circumstances, they are advised to call their
   reporting manager/HR and inform them about the inability before the start of
   business hours. Any absence on a working day, without prior approval of the
   reporting manager shall be construed to be an unauthorized absence and would
   result in loss of pay and/or disciplinary action.
   Any continuous absence of 2 or more working days without prior approval of the
   reporting manager shall be construed to be a long unauthorized absence. This also
   includes cases of absence on medical grounds without intimation/approval.
   A long unauthorized absence as defined above shall result in loss of lien on service.
   The employee shall be given two successive opportunities to resume duty and
   explain his/her position and if he/she fails to make use of said opportunities final
   notice shall be issued intimating loss of lien on service resulting in termination.




                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                42
Computing & Recording of Leaves
  All leaves have to be marked in advance & can only be availed ONLY after approval
  from the reporting manager in the HRMS, except in the case of an emergency like
  Sick Leave, which should also be marked within 1 day of return to work.
  Sanctioning of leave is at the discretion of the reporting manager. Leave approvals
  should be based on operational requirements, merit, reasonability and past record.
  Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Any kind of leave can be granted or
  refused depending upon the business demands. Leave of absence from work
  without proper approval will call for disciplinary action.


Administrative Information
  The policy will be reviewed whenever necessary, and changes as considered
  important will be incorporated in the policy.
  Exceptions to the policy will be handled on a case-to-case basis, by the Human
  Resources Department.




                            Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              43
11. Probation & Termination




At Lyzr, all employees will serve a probationary period of at least three months from their
date of joining, which may be extended or shortened at the discretion of the
management. During or at the end of the probation period, whether extended or
curtailed, the Company reserves the right to terminate employment immediately without
notice.


If an employee wishes to resign during the probationary period, they are required to give
one month’s notice to the Company. After confirmation of employment, the Company will
require one month’s notice for termination, except in cases of breach of discipline,
insubordination, non-performance, unauthorized leave, dishonesty, breach of trust,
negligence, or misconduct. In such cases, employment can be terminated immediately,
without notice, and the Company will not be liable for any further compensation.


Upon termination, regardless of the reason, all benefits provided to the employee during
the course of employment will cease to exist. This includes the cancellation of any
business-related visas provided by the Company.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 44
12. Travel
Purpose
This Travel Policy outlines the company’s guidelines for employee business travel within
and between India and the United States. It aims to ensure that all travel is safe, cost-
effective, and supports the business objectives of the organization while promoting a
positive employee experience.




Scope
This policy applies to all employees of Lyzr located in India and the U.S. who are required
to travel for business purposes. This includes employees in hybrid, remote, and office-
based roles.



                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 45
Approval Process
All business travel must be pre-approved by the employee's manager and the relevant
department head.


International travel between India and the U.S. also requires approval from the Chief
Executive Officer (CEO).

Travel requests must be submitted via the company’s designated travel management
platform on HRMS, including details such as purpose, itinerary, estimated expenses, and
any travel-related documents.


Travel Categories and Guidelines
a. Domestic Travel (Within India or the U.S.)
   Transportation: Employees are encouraged to use cost-effective options like
   economy class flights, trains, or approved ride-sharing services. Employees may
   use personal vehicles when approved in advance and will be reimbursed based on
   distance travelled as per company rates.
   Accommodation: Standard accommodations will be provided. Employees should
   book through company-approved vendors or platforms.
   Meals: Daily meal allowances will be reimbursed based on location-specific rates.


b. International Travel (Between India and the U.S.)
   Transportation: Employees will travel in economy class, unless otherwise specified.
   Accommodation: Similar to domestic travel, standard accommodations will be
   covered. Upgrades require prior approval.
   Per Diem Allowance: A daily allowance will be provided for meals and incidentals
   based on current exchange rates and cost-of-living adjustments between the two
   countries.
   Visa and Immigration Support: The company will reimburse or cover visa application
   fees and any necessary immunizations or health checks.


Travel Categories and Guidelines
Employees are responsible for maintaining receipts for all travel-related expenses.
Digital copies must be submitted through the designated expense management system
(HRMS) within 30 days of completing the trip.


                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              46
The following expenses are reimbursable:
   Airfare, train, and approved ground transportation.
   Accommodation costs, within the approved budget.
    Meal costs within the daily per diem limit.
    Reasonable costs for business-related supplies or services during the trip.
    Airport parking, tolls, and baggage fees (when approved).


Expenses will be reimbursed only against the actual bills, invoices or other valid
documents, subject to the maximum reimbursement allowed against the said nature of
expense.


Non-reimbursable expenses include, but are not limited to, in-room entertainment,
personal phone calls, and alcohol purchases.



Health, Safety, and Security
Pre-Travel Health Measures: Employees are encouraged to check government health
advisories and consult with healthcare professionals as needed.
Emergency Support: The company offers 24/7 travel support through our third-party
travel assistance provider for emergencies, including medical assistance, travel
document replacement, and security evacuation if necessary.


Remote Work While Traveling
Employees on approved business trips may work remotely from their travel destination
with prior approval, provided that they have adequate resources and internet
connectivity.


Sustainability
In line with Lyzr’s sustainability efforts, employees are encouraged to consider remote
alternatives to travel, such as video conferencing, wherever feasible.

Violation of Policy
Non-compliance with this policy may result in delayed reimbursement and could lead to
disciplinary action. Intentional submission of false claims will be grounds for disciplinary
measures, up to and including termination.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  47
13. Communication
Confidentiality
To support employees, Lyzr ensures that during their tenure, they have access to the
Company's confidential information in a secure manner and agree to adhere to Lyzr's
Confidentiality and Intellectual Property Rights Agreement.




Internal & External Communication
The purpose of this policy is to establish clear guidelines for internal and external
communication, ensuring that information is shared efficiently, securely, and
respectfully. This policy supports collaboration, transparency, and professionalism
within Lyzr’s work culture.


This policy applies to all employees, interns, trainees, contractors, and consultants of
Lyzr. It governs the use of email, chat platforms, video conferencing, social media, and
any other company-approved communication channels.


                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               48
Core Communication Principles
   Transparency: Communicate openly and honestly to foster a culture of trust.
   Responsiveness: Respond to messages within a reasonable timeframe, ideally
   within 12 hours during business days, unless specified otherwise.
   Respect: Engage with all colleagues and external parties professionally and
   respectfully.
   Confidentiality: Maintain confidentiality for sensitive or proprietary information in all
   communications.

Communication Channels & Their Usage
a. Email
   Purpose: Use for formal communications, important announcements, and
   documentation.
   Expectations: Keep emails concise and relevant, using clear subject lines. Avoid
   using "Reply All" unless absolutely necessary.
   Etiquette: Follow standard professional email etiquette, including polite greetings,
   concise content, and a clear closing.
   Signature: Use company approved standard email signature for all emails.

b. Instant Messaging Platforms (e.g., Slack, Google Meets)
   Purpose: Ideal for quick, informal communications and team collaboration.
   Expectations: Use these platforms for questions, brainstorming, and real-time
   updates. For high-urgency issues, use direct messages (DM) or mention the person
   specifically.
   Etiquette: Avoid excessive notifications by respecting work hours and using
   channels rather than DMs for non-urgent matters. Messages should remain
   respectful and relevant to work discussions.

c. Video Conferencing (Google Meet, Zoom)
   Purpose: For team meetings, client, customer calls, and discussions requiring visual
   collaboration.
   Expectations: Ensure meetings have a clear agenda and that only essential
   participants are invited. Use video settings as preferred, but aim for professionalism
   in background and attire.
   Etiquette: Join meetings on time, remain engaged, and avoid distractions like
   multitasking during calls. Provide a reason or explanation when declining a meeting
   invitation.


                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   49
d. Project Management Tools
   Purpose: To share project updates, progress tracking, and documentation.
   Expectations: Update task statuses, deadlines, and any relevant documentation in a
   timely manner.
   Etiquette: Keep comments concise and clear, tagging only relevant team members.



External Communication
a. Client and Partner Communication
   Professionalism: All external communication with clients, vendors, or partners
   should be professional and align with company values. Avoid informal language
   unless appropriate for the relationship.
   Confidentiality: Do not disclose any proprietary or confidential information without
   proper authorization.
b. Media and Social Media Engagement
   Spokesperson: Only designated employees or the marketing team may
   communicate on behalf of the company to the media.
   Social Media: Employees are not permitted to use social media sites for personal
   purposes on company devices. Use on personal devices is allowed, but we expect
   responsible usage to avoid impacting productivity.


Guidelines for Social Media Conduct:
   Employees are encouraged to share public company news but should avoid
   discussing internal matters or confidential information.
   Clearly indicate that personal opinions are not on behalf of Lyzr.
   Do not imply company endorsement of personal content.
   Avoid sharing company trademarks.
   Refrain from defamatory or offensive remarks, especially regarding colleagues,
   clients, or partners, as this may breach our anti-harassment policy.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              50
Information Security & Confidentiality
Data Protection: Use company-approved platforms for communication, particularly for
sharing confidential information. Avoid discussing sensitive topics on unsecure
platforms.
Confidentiality Agreements: Employees must adhere to confidentiality agreements in all
forms of communication.
Cybersecurity: Be mindful of phishing attempts and report any suspicious
communications to IT. Use strong passwords and enable two-factor authentication
where available.


Communication for Remote & Hybrid Teams
Flexibility: Remote and hybrid team members should have flexibility in communication
methods while adhering to core business hours unless otherwise agreed upon.
Availability Status: Employees are encouraged to update their availability status (e.g., "In
a Meeting," "Available") on messaging platforms to help manage expectations.


Conflict Resolution & Feedback
Conflict Resolution: Address conflicts privately and respectfully. Use direct
communication to resolve issues before involving supervisors or HR.
Feedback: Provide constructive feedback to colleagues and be open to receiving
feedback. Use 1:1 meetings or feedback tools for sensitive topics.


Non-Compliance
Violations of this policy may result in corrective actions. Deliberate breaches of
confidentiality or disrespectful communication will lead to disciplinary measures, up to
termination if warranted.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  51
14. Software & Tools




Purpose
This policy provides guidelines for the proper use of company-approved software and
tools to enhance productivity, maintain security, and ensure compliance with company
standards. The policy outlines the software usage, access, and security protocols
required to protect company data and intellectual property.

Scope
This policy applies to all employees, contractors, interns, trainees and consultants at
Lyzr. It includes any software or tools used on company-owned devices, personal
devices (for remote or hybrid employees), or cloud environments accessible via the
company network.

Approved Software and Tools
The following software and tools are approved for use based on job function. Employees
should avoid using unapproved software or tools for company work without prior
authorization.

General Tools
 1. Google Chrome: Standard browser for all web-based activities. Users should ensure
    they are logged into their company account and maintain secure browsing
    practices.
 2. Company VPN Client: Required for secure access to company resources when
   working remotely. All remote or off-site work must be conducted through the VPN to
   ensure secure access to internal systems.



                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               52
Technical roles (Engineering, Development)
 1. VS Code: Primary code editor for development work. Employees in technical roles
    should maintain version control practices in alignment with company standards.
 2. PyCharm: Approved for Python development. Users are encouraged to integrate it
    with Git for streamlined version control.
 3. Git: Required for all code version control and collaboration. Employees must push
    code changes to approved company repositories and follow the company’s version
    control procedures.
 4. Docker: Used for application containerization. Employees should follow best
    practices to maintain secure, scalable development environments and avoid using
   public images without security checks.


Software Installation and Updates
   Installation Process: All approved software installations should be conducted via the
   company’s IT department or through the company’s software portal. Employees are
   not permitted to download or install additional software without written approval.
   Automatic Updates: Where applicable, enable automatic updates to ensure that the
   software is running the latest, most secure versions. For tools like Docker and Git,
   employees should check for updates regularly and notify the IT team of any issues
   with version compatibility.
   Configuration: Employees must configure their software per company guidelines,
   including necessary security settings for Chrome, VS Code, and PyCharm.


Access and Security Protocols
Company VPN Client
   Usage Requirement: Employees must connect to the VPN for any remote work,
   especially when accessing sensitive or proprietary company data.
   Access Restrictions: Only company devices or approved personal devices may
   connect to the VPN. Use of VPN on shared or public devices is prohibited.
   Security: Ensure VPN credentials are kept secure and report any suspicious activity
   to IT immediately.




                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                53
Version Control and Code Security
   Git Usage: Employees should only use Git with authorized company repositories.
   Use descriptive commit messages and regularly sync with the main branch as per
   company guidelines.
   Data Protection: Sensitive data (such as credentials, API keys, or confidential
   business logic) must not be stored in code repositories without encryption or other
   security measures.
   Docker Security Practices
   Image Usage: Use only approved Docker images or ones verified by the company for
   security compliance. Avoid pulling images from untrusted sources.
   Container Management: Delete unused containers and images to minimize security
   risks, and follow company guidance for container security configurations.


Acceptable Use and Prohibited Actions
Acceptable Use
All approved software and tools should be used strictly for work-related purposes.
Personal use of company software is discouraged and must not compromise data
security.

Prohibited Actions
   Installing or using unapproved software.
   Disabling security features or VPN requirements.
   Sharing company software licenses or credentials with unauthorized users.
   Altering or tampering with company configurations on tools like Git or Docker.


Data Backup and Recovery
All project-related work in Git must be regularly committed and pushed to the company’s
central repositories to ensure data backup.
Important work-related files, particularly those involving collaborative projects, should
be backed up according to company protocols.


Monitoring and Compliance
The IT department may monitor software usage to ensure compliance with this policy,
protecting against security risks and unauthorized software installations.
Employees found in violation of this policy may face corrective actions, including
restricted access, required security training, or disciplinary action including termination
of employment.

                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 54
15. Internet Usage
The company has guidelines for internet use on company devices, including laptops,
smartphones, and other devices. Unauthorized or inappropriate internet use is strictly
prohibited. This policy applies to all employees, contractors, consultants, trainees and
interns with network access.




Employees’ responsibilities
   Keep passwords confidential.
   Use strong passwords for work accounts.
   Access corporate accounts only from secure devices.

Prohibited Activities
   Downloading offensive, illegal, or copyrighted content.
   Sending confidential information to unauthorized recipients.
   Violating others' privacy.
Non-compliance may result in disciplinary action, up to termination or legal measures for
serious offenses.

17. Privacy & Confidentiality




At Lyzr, we believe that trust is built on transparency and respect. As part of our

your personal data and our company’s confidential information seriously. This section
outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard employee information, what your
responsibilities are, and how we work together to maintain privacy and confidentiality
across the organization.


Your Personal Information and How We Use It
During the course of your employment at Lyzr, we collect and process certain personal
data that is necessary for hiring, onboarding, performance management, payroll,
benefits, compliance, and business operations. This may include:




                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              57
   Your name and contact details
   Resume, background verification records, and interview assessments
   Educational and employment history
   Time and attendance data
   Performance evaluations, training records, and system usage logs
   Emergency contact and medical information (if applicable)

We only collect data that is relevant to your role and responsibilities. In some cases, we
may also receive your information from third-party service providers such as
background verification agencies.



Why We Collect This Information
We collect and process your personal data under legitimate business purposes,
including:

   Managing your employment contract
   Ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory obligations
   Processing payroll and benefits
   Enabling IT and information security
   Supporting training, development, and performance reviews
   Responding to emergencies and safeguarding your well-being

Where required, we also collect your consent-particularly for optional programs,
voluntary benefits, and inclusion initiatives.


Keeping Your Information Safe
Lyzr has implemented robust technical and administrative measures to keep your data
safe. This includes:

   Role-based access control
   Encryption of sensitive data
   Secure storage of physical and digital records
   Use of trusted, privacy-compliant service providers

Only authorized team members have access to your data, and only for work-related
reasons. We regularly audit our systems, and you will always be notified in case of a
data breach that affects your information.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 58
Your Rights as a Team Member

    Access your personal data held by Lyzr
    Correct any outdated or incorrect information

concerns.

    CCTV cameras in office premises
    Access logs and IT monitoring tools for system security
    Communication monitoring on company platforms for compliance purposes

Monitoring is conducted fairly and transparently, and always in line with our privacy and
ethical standards.


Data Retention

    Personnel and payroll records: 7 years post-employment
    IT access logs: 2 years
    Background verification reports: retained per legal or operational requirements

Once the data is no longer needed, it is securely deleted or destroyed.


Third-Party Access

At Lyzr, privacy and confidentiality aren’t just policies-they’re part of our shared

18. Non-Compete & Non-Solicitation
At Lyzr, we believe in fostering a positive and collaborative work environment, both during

   During your time with Lyzr, we encourage you to fully engage with the projects, clients,

   from engaging in any personal or professional activities that directly or indirectly
   compete with the Company's business. This includes collaborating with Lyzr's clients
   or participating in similar business ventures, whether within or outside India.
   Additionally, we trust that you will honor the relationships you've built with our clients
   and colleagues. After your employment with Lyzr, we ask that you avoid directly or
   indirectly soliciting or attempting to take away clients, prospects, or fellow employees
   for your own purposes or for any other business, for a period of two years.
   These guidelines are designed to protect the integrity of Lyzr’s business and ensure
   that you continue to thrive professionally without conflicting interests. Your efforts
   during and after your time with us are greatly appreciated, and we trust that you will
   uphold the strong relationships and values we've worked so hard to build together.

19. Personal Consequences




At Lyzr, we are committed to maintaining a respectful and professional work
environment for everyone. While we value your contributions, it’s important to maintain
clear expectations for the protection of both the Company and its employees. Therefore,
your employment with Lyzr may be subject to cessation or termination if the following
situations arise, at the sole discretion of the Company:

 1. If it’s found that you are involved in any other gainful or commercial employment,
    business, or activity—whether part-time or full-time—during your employment with
    Lyzr, without prior approval from the Company.
 2. If you are declared medically unfit by a registered medical practitioner and are
    unable to fulfill the duties of your role.
 3. If you are convicted of any civil or criminal offence, including financial impropriety,
    moral turpitude, or misappropriating the Company’s assets or the property of any
    third party.
 4. If you are found to be bound by any restrictive clauses such as non-compete or non-
    solicitation agreements with previous employers, or if you breach any of the terms
    outlined in your employment contract or this employee playbook.
 5. If you are found guilty of sexual harassment, whether it occurs while working with the
   Company or at any time prior to your employment with us.

These conditions are in place to ensure the integrity and well-being of the Company and
its employees, and we trust that you will uphold the values that make Lyzr a great place
to work.
