20. Performance Review




At Lyzr, we believe in recognizing and rewarding your contributions while supporting
your growth. Our Performance Review process is designed to assess your productivity,
attitude, and overall alignment with the company's goals, based on the pre-set
objectives and Key Result Areas (KRAs).

We conduct Annual Appraisals every October, which are available to employees who
have completed at least one year with the Company, subject to management's
discretion. These appraisals assess your performance and provide valuable insights,
which are also used as inputs for the Annual Compensation Review, held in November
each year.


Please note that a Performance Review does not automatically guarantee a
compensation increase or revision. Reviews conducted after the completion of
probation will focus on performance alignment and will not include compensation
adjustments.


                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                            63
Compensation reviews and increments are exclusively conducted in November for all
confirmed employees.

In addition, we offer continuous feedback throughout the year via Quarterly Feedback
sessions with your Reporting Manager, to ensure your performance aligns with your
goals. These quarterly discussions also contribute to your Annual Performance
Appraisal.


You can access your KRAs and appraisal forms through the HRMS, ensuring you're
always up-to-date on your progress and expectations.


Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)
At Lyzr, we are committed to supporting employees in their growth and success. If an
employee faces challenges in meeting their duties, despite receiving the necessary
support, training, and feedback, or if they engage in misconduct such as insubordination,
unauthorized leave, dishonesty, or neglect of duties, a Performance Improvement Plan
(PIP) will be implemented to help them improve.


The Reporting Manager will outline the areas of improvement and communicate them to
the HR team, who will then review the feedback and issue the PIP to the employee. The
duration of the PIP will typically range from 15 days to 3 months, depending on the
manager’s discretion.


During the PIP, the employee is expected to actively engage with the recommendations
and work towards improving performance and behavior. An employee can be placed on
a PIP twice. If there is no improvement or if the issues reoccur, further disciplinary action,
including termination of employment, may be considered.


For behavioral issues, the PIP should be initiated within 30 days of the incident, with a
duration not exceeding 3 months.


Please note, employees on a PIP are not eligible for performance incentives, bonuses,
rewards, recognition, or promotions during the PIP period.


Once the employee shows significant improvement, the Reporting Manager will assess
progress, and if warranted, close the PIP. The HR team must be informed when the PIP is
officially closed.



                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   64
21. Separation




Voluntary Separation
To initiate the resignation process, an employee must submit a resignation notice to their
Reporting Manager via the HRMS, adhering to the 30 day notice period requirement.


The date of resignation on HRMS will be considered the 1st day of the notice period.
However, if the resignation is sent beyond the business hours on a working day or on a
weekly off or on a holiday, notice period would start from the next working day.


The resignation has to be accepted by the Reporting Manager & HR for the employee to
receive a relieving letter from the Company.


An employee who does not serve the notice period but resigns without acceptance from
HR will be considered as absconding from duties.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                65
Absconding from Duty
Once an employee is absconding from duty, the Reporting Manager is immediately
required to inform the HR team. The HR department will send two reminders to the
employee to immediately report to work.

   First reminder: Emails (Official & personal email ID) along with text message on
   mobile. If no response is received within 24 hours;
   Second reminder: through Registered Post will be sent to the permanent residential
   address of the Employee.

If the employee does not report back to work within 7 days of sending the registered
post, the employment will be terminated with immediate effect.

Involuntary Separation may occur in the following cases:


 1. Death
 2. Disability
 3. Termination of employment


Termination of Employment
The employer has the prerogative to terminate the employment without any notice in the
event of insubordination, indiscipline, unauthorized leave, non-performance, dishonesty,
violation of any other terms and conditions of Letter of Appointment and/or terms
contained herein, gross negligence of duty or refusal to carry out lawful instructions
despite 3 (three) warnings. Further, in such cases employees will be paid only for the
actual days worked. For other reasons for termination, up to 30 days of notice pay will be
given by the Company subject to the sole discretion of the Management.


Retirement from Services
The employee will be retired from service on attaining age of 58 years or earlier, in case,
the employee is found physically or mentally unfit to work any longer or for continued ill
health as certified by the medical officer/ medical practitioner.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 66
Notice Period
An employee is required to serve a minimum 30 days’ notice period as prescribed in the
Appointment Letter.


When an employee resigns from Lyzr, their last month's salary will be withheld, and any
outstanding amounts will be paid during the Full & Final settlement after their last working
day.


An employee who has resigned from Lyzr cannot avail any leaves during the notice period.


Any leaves taken during the notice period will get deducted in the salary as adjustments or
the notice period may get extended for the number of leaves taken, at the discretion of the
management.

Continued/prolonged, unapproved absence from work is unacceptable both during
employment and while serving the notice period. This may lead to disciplinary action
including termination of employment with immediate effect.


A resigned employee is required to complete the handover and any other knowledge
transfer as per the instructions of the Reporting Manager.
A resigned employee may be stopped from attending Employee Development Programmes
including training, at the discretion of the Management.


It is also the employee's responsibility to ensure that all company-related files, documents,
communications, and data are fully handed over to an authorized person and that no
company-related data is stored on personal devices, hard drives, cloud services, or email
accounts.

In case an employee wants to seek notice period waiver, the request should be made by
the employee to the Function Head, who would decide on the same on the basis of business
exigencies. The waiver is completely at management's discretion and a request does not
make the employee eligible for the same.


In case of notice period waiver approval, accumulated Causal Leaves as of date would be
adjusted in the shortfall of notice period. The remaining shortfall would be recovered as
notice pay from the resigned employee during Full & Final Settlement. Please note, auto
adjustment of Casual Leaves against notice period is not allowed.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              67
Full & Final Settlement
The Full and Final settlement includes, last month's withheld salary, earned leave
encashment (if any) & any other dues settlement, as stated above.
Full and final settlement will be paid by Cheque or credited into the salary account after 45
days counting from the last working day of the month of exit.

In case of termination the full and final settlement will be done in 10 days counting from the
last working day of the month of exit.


Full & final settlement statement will be sent to the ex-employee at the time of bank credit.


Relieving letter would be issued along with Full & Final Settlement. Relieved employees are
required to go through the final settlement and contact HR for any clarifications.



Exit Clearance Process
A mail from HRMS will be sent to the resigned employees with the separation checklist
before the last working day.

The employee shall obtain all necessary approvals as per the "Separation Checklist" and
hand over the same to HR & Reporting Manager on the last working day, before the close
of business hours.


As part of exit clearance, employees would be required to:
    Prepare transition documents and obtain Manager’s approval.
   Fill up the Exit Interview Questionnaire Hand over all Company assets including
   Laptop, Mobile Phone, data card etc.
   Submit Tax proofs.
   File unclaimed expenses with necessary documentation.
   Settle outstanding loans/advances/recoveries.
   Submit Gratuity Payment form (if eligible).




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               68
Gratuity
   Gratuity shall be paid to the exiting employee if the employee has completed a
   minimum 5 years of continuous employment as on the date of exit or in case of
   separation on grounds of retirement or death.
   Gratuity payment shall be calculated as per the rules of the Payment of Gratuity Act,
   1972.
   Employees shall submit the necessary forms at the time of exit to facilitate Gratuity
   payout.


Recoveries
An employee leaving the company shall be liable to repay to Lyzr any amounts due, like
the Relocation, joining bonus, training etc that are applicable to him/her.

Any outstanding loan/advance of the employee who has resigned will be recovered over
the remaining working days and in case of any excess recovery, an employee shall pay
the same through Cheque or demand draft to complete the exit clearance process.


Employees Obligations Upon Separation
The employee’s obligations with respect to Confidential Information and security of the
Confidential Information shall continue and survive even after the termination of
employment with the Company.


This includes the applicable clauses of Conflict of Interest, Intellectual Property Rights
and Confidential and Non-Disclosure Agreement signed by the employee at any stage of
the employment.


Experience Certificate
The Experience and relieving letter will be issued along with full and final settlement,
subject to exit clearance and settlement of any recovery that has to be made from the
employee.


Resignation Withdrawal
A resignation can be withdrawn by an employee by formally informing their Reporting
Manager and HR, with a copy to the Function Head before the end of the last working
day.

                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 69
22. Employee Referral
All full-time employees of Lyzr are eligible to participate in the referral program, except
for the Founding team, HR or those involved in the hiring process for the referred position.




Referral Eligibility & Relationship Disclosure
To preserve the integrity of the Employee Referral Program while keeping our hiring bar
as the primary quality filter, the following framework applies to all referrals submitted
under Section 22.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  70
Ineligible Referrals
The following referrals do not qualify for the referral bonus, even if the candidate is hired:
    Social media–only connections: Candidates known to the referrer solely through
    social or professional networking platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, etc.)
    without prior professional collaboration, working relationship, or substantive
    personal acquaintance.
A "vouch" is the core of a referral. Where no such basis exists, the referral does not
qualify, regardless of hiring outcome.


Referrals Requiring Disclosure
The following referrals are eligible for the referral bonus, but are subject to mandatory
disclosure and review before payout:
    Family and personal relationships: Including but not limited to spouses, domestic
    partners, parents, siblings, children, in-laws, and extended family members.
The referring employee must declare the relationship at the time of submitting the
Referral Form. The referred candidate cannot fall within the referrer's direct or indirect
reporting line (upward or downward) at the time of hire or at any point during the
referrer's continued employment. The People team will review and confirm eligibility
before bonus payout.
If a reporting-line conflict arises post-hire (e.g., due to a reorganisation), the bonus
already paid is not clawed back, but reporting structures will be adjusted to remove the
conflict.


Eligible Referrals
    Professional network and acquaintances, including connections made through
    industry events, community groups, alumni networks, or other non-family channels,
    qualify for the standard referral bonus, provided the candidate clears Lyzr's hiring
    process and completes the probation period.


Non-Disclosure or Misrepresentation
Failure to disclose a family or personal relationship at the time of referral submission will
result in forfeiture of the referral bonus and may be treated as a breach of the Code of
Conduct under Section 1.


Final Authority
The People team holds final authority on referral bonus eligibility under this clause. Any
disputes may be escalated to the CBO.


                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   71
Incentive Structure
 1. Reward: If the referred employee successfully completes the probation period, the
    referring employee will receive a reward equivalent to one month of their base
    salary.
 2. Conditions:
  The referring employee must still be employed with Lyzr AI India Private Limited at
  the time the referred employee completes their probation period to claim the reward.
  If the referring employee leaves the company before the completion of the referred
  employee's probation period, they forfeit the reward.
  This policy does not apply to founding team members, functional leaders and the HR
  department. When leaders source candidates directly from their own professional
  networks to build their own teams, such referrals will not be eligible for a referral
  bonus, as this is considered part of their leadership responsibility.
  However, cross-functional referrals by functional leaders, where employees refer
  candidates for roles outside their own teams will remain eligible for referral bonus.
  If multiple employees, recruiters, or external sources refer to the same candidate,
  the individual who uploads the profile first in the system will be given credit.
  Cooling period: If a candidate is not selected within a recruitment cycle, the same
  candidate can be referred to the company again 1 year later.



Legal and Ethical Considerations
 1. Equal Opportunity: The referral program will ensure that all referred candidates are
    evaluated based on merit and fit for the role, promoting diversity and inclusion within
    the company.
 2. Transparency: The referral process and criteria for rewards will be transparent to
   avoid any perceptions of favouritism or unfair advantage.


How to Participate
 1. Submit a Referral: Fill out the Referral Form on the HRMS
 2. Follow-up: HR will keep you updated on the status of your referral.
 3. Receive Your Reward: If your referral is hired and completes the probation period
    while you are still with the company, you will receive a reward equivalent to one
   month of your base salary.

24. Sexual Harassment Policy
Lyzr AI India Private Limited (“Company/Lyzr”) has formulated this sexual harassment
policy (“the Policy”) aims to protect women in the Company from unwanted sexual
advances and give them guidelines to report incidents.




Lyzr won’t tolerate sexual harassment in the Workplace (defined below) or any other work
location in any shape or form. Our culture is based on mutual respect and collaboration.
sexual harassment of any kind is a serious violation of these principles. Lyzr understands
that sexual harassment of women at Workplace is a form of discrimination against women
and recognizes that it violates the constitutional right to equality and the right to live with
dignity, respect and decency at the Workplace.


Objective of the Policy
The objective of this Policy is to create and maintain a safe, secure and enabling working
environment to every woman employee, irrespective of her age or employment status,
where all employees treat each other with courtesy, dignity and respect without any
discrimination on grounds of sexual orientation. The objective of the Policy is multifold:
  1. Prevent Sexual Harassment at Workplace.
 2. Prohibit such misconduct by imposing certain obligations on the stakeholders.
 3. Provide redressal to the Complainant



                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                76
In furtherance to the above, the Policy provides detail procedures to be followed when
an employee believes that a violation of the Policy has occurred within the ambit of all
applicable law regarding Sexual Harassment and provides for the constitution of
appropriate committee to take action against sexual harassment at Workplace.


Prevention of Sexual Harassment
The present Policy is in accordance with the Sexual Harassment of Women at
Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition & Redressal) Act, 2013 (“POSH Act”) and other
applicable laws for the time being in force in India. Any matters not covered in this Policy
shall be interpreted in accordance with the POSH Act.


Commitment
Lyzr and its affiliates, subsidiaries are committed to provide a work environment that
ensures every employee is treated with dignity, respect and accorded an equitable
treatment. The Company is committed to promote a work environment that is conducive
to the professional growth of its employees and encourages equality of opportunity. The
Company does not tolerate any form of Sexual Harassment and is committed to take all
necessary steps, in accordance with the law, to ensure that
  1. its women employees are not subjected to any form of Sexual Harassment; and
  2. Its male employees are not victims of misuse of the Policy or the POSH Act by the
     women employees.



Scope
  1. This Policy applies to all categories of employees of the Company, including
     permanent management, temporaries, probationary or part-time or working as a
    consultant or on a voluntary basis or ad-hoc basis, or engaged through a contractor
    or agent, whether for a remuneration or not and includes apprentice, trainees,
    interns and employees on contract at Company’s Workplace or at client sites. The
    Company will not tolerate any kind of Sexual Harassment, if engaged in by any of its
    employee, clients or by suppliers or any other business associates at Workplace.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  77
2. The workplace shall mean to include (“Workplace”):
    All offices of the Company, its affiliates and subsidiaries, or other premises where the
    Company’s business is conducted including such premises, locations, branches
   established, owned and/or controlled by the Company.
   All Company-related activities performed at any other site away from the Company’s
   premises; and
   a dwelling place or home of any employee
   any place wherein work-related event or activity whether conducted inside or
   outside the office premises, during or after office hours
   any place visited by the employee arising out of or during the course of employment,
   and transportation provided by the Company for undertaking such journey; and
   Any social, business or other functions where the conduct or comments may have
   an adverse impact on the workplace or workplace relations.


Sexual Harassment
What is Sexual Harassment?
 1. Sexual Harassment would mean any or all unwelcome acts or behaviour (directly or
    implied) which may occur within or outside the working hours whether in or outside
    of the Workplace, including but not limited to includes such unwelcome sexually
    determined behaviours, as physical contacts and advances, sexually coloured
    remarks, showing pornography and sexual demands whether by words, gestures or
    actions (“Sexual Harassment”). Such conduct can be humiliating and may constitute
    a health and safety problem.
 2. Examples of Sexual Harassment shall include but is not limited to unwelcome sexual
    advances involving verbal, non-verbal, or physical conduct such as sexually
   coloured remarks, jokes, letters, phone calls, any form of messages, e- mail, lurid
   stares, physical contact or molestation, stalking, sounds, display of pictures, signs,
   verbal or non-verbal communication which offends the individual’s sensibilities and
   affect her performance. Eve teasing, innuendos and taunts, physical confinement
   against one’s will and likely to intrude upon one’s privacy.


Quid Pro Quo
Quid Pro Quo shall mean such form of Sexual Harassment, where a person or authority,
usually the superior of the Complainant (defined below), demands sexual favours for
getting or keeping a job benefit and threatens to fire or transfer etc. the employee if the
demands conditions are not met.



                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  78
Creation of A Hostile Work Environment
1. A hostile work environment arises when a co-worker or supervisor creates a work
   environment through verbal or physical conduct that interferes with another co-
   worker’s job performance or creates the Workplace atmosphere which is
   intimidating, hostile, offensive or humiliating and experienced as an attack on
   personal dignity. For example: an employee tells offensive jokes. Such acts may also
   include the presence or circumstance of:


      implied or explicit promise of preferential treatment in employment;
      threat of detrimental treatment in employment;
      threat about present or future employment;


2. No person shall indulge or caused to be indulged under instructions from superior in
   Sexual Harassment of co-workers. However, any woman employee who is sexually
   harassed can complain about the same even if there is no adverse job consequence.

3. It is discriminatory when the woman employee has reasonable grounds to believe
  that her objection would disadvantage them in connection with employment,
  including recruiting or promotion or when it creates a hostile working environment.


Complainant and Respondent
1. Complainant shall mean a woman, of any age whether employed or not, who alleges
   to have been subjected to any act of Sexual Harassment by the Respondent
   (“Complainant”). Respondent shall mean the person against whom the Complainant
   has made a complaint (“Respondent”).

2. Whether or not such conduct constitutes an offence under law and a breach of the
   employment rules, the Company will ensure that any Complainant will not suffer
  adverse job consequences as a result of any complaint being made against the
  Respondent.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              79
3. Internal Complaints Committee – “ICC”:
  The Company shall form an Internal Complaints Committee for redressal of Sexual
  Harassment complaints and for ensuring time bound treatment and resolution of such
  complaints as per the POSH Act (“Internal Complaints Committee/ICC”). Initially, and
  for a period of 3 years from the date of the appointment of the following members
  (“Member”), the ICC will comprise of the following four Members:

  Member 1: Siva Surendira, Founder and CEO, email: siva@Lyzr.ai


  Member 2: Shalini Sunderraman, HR Director, email: shalini@Lyzr.ai (“Presiding
  Officer”)

  Member 3: Sejal Agarwal, Employee Experience Associate, email: sejal@lyzr.ai


  Member 4: Vishaka Sivakumar - External Advisor/External Member, email:
  vishaka@eshwars.com


4. The Company shall have the right to reconstitute the ICC and shall notify the
   employees of the same. The Members may be removed from their position, and the
   ICC shall be reconstituted in any of the following cases:
      If the Members contravenes the provisions of the Act; or
      If the Member has been convicted for an offence or an inquiry into an offence
      under law for the time being in force is pending against the Member; or
      If the Member has been found guilty in any disciplinary proceedings or a
      disciplinary proceeding is pending against the Member
      If the Member has so abused his/her position as to render its continuance in office
      prejudicial to the public interest


5. The Internal Complaints Committee is responsible for:
      Investigating every formal written complaint of Sexual Harassment
      Taking appropriate remedial measures to respond to any substantiated
      allegations of Sexual Harassment
      Discouraging and preventing any Sexual Harassment at Workplace.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               80
Procedures for Conciliation
The Company is committed to provide a supportive environment to resolve concerns of
Sexual Harassment as under:

1. nformal Resolution Options/Conciliation:
       When an incident of Sexual Harassment occurs, the woman employee of such
       conduct can communicate her disapproval and objections immediately to the
       harasser and request the harasser to desist from such conduct in the future.
       If the Sexual Harassment does not stop or if the woman employee is not
       comfortable with addressing the harasser directly, she can bring the concern to
       the attention of the ICC for redressal of grievances. The ICC will thereafter provide
       advice or extend support as requested and will do the needful to resolve the
       matter between woman employee and the harasser through conciliation.
       It is advisable that the woman employee keeps a record of incident i.e. date, place,
       possible witness and file a complaint as soon as possible.
      ICC shall ensure that no monetary settlement shall be the basis of conciliation.
      ICC shall record the settlement terms so arrived and forward the same to the
      Company.
      Copy of settlement shall be given to the woman employee and the harasser.


2. Procedure for complaints before the ICC:
      Any of the Company’s woman employee with a Sexual Harassment concern, who
      is not comfortable with the informal resolution option or has exhausted such
      option, may make a formal complaint to the ICC in writing. The Complainant should
      make a complaint within three months from the date of occurrence of the event or
      in a case of series of incidents, within a period of three months from the date of the
      last occurrence.
      The complaint should be submitted in writing for it to be considered as formal and
      for the ICC to probe and take the necessary actions. The Complainant may submit
      the complaint in the form of a written letter, duly signed by the Complainant and
      submit it to the ICC. Alternatively, the Complainant may also send an email to the
      ICC. The Complainant should disclose her name, department, details of
      Respondent, date of occurrence, place of occurrence in the complaint letter, along
      with the evidences of harassment (if any) and/or witnesses in support of her
      complaint. The Complainant can also take all reasonable assistance from any of
      the ICC to make the complaint in writing and ICC shall render all reasonable
      assistance to the Complainant for reducing the complaint in writing in case the
      complaint cannot be made in writing by the Complainant.



                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  81
3. In case the Complainant is unable to make complaint on account of her physical or
   mental incapacity, or death or otherwise, the following persons may make a
   complaint on behalf of the Complainant:

  i. In case of physical incapacity of Complainant:
         her relative or friend; or
         her co-worker
         an officer of the National or State commission for Women
         any person who has the knowledge of the incident, with written consent of the
         Complainant

  ii. In case of mental incapacity of Complainant:
          her relative or friend; or
          a special educator; or
          a qualified psychiatrist or psychologist
          the guardian or authority who is treating her or taking care of her
          any person who has the knowledge of the incident jointly with any of the above
          mentioned.


4. If any complaints are received by any of the Member of the ICC, such Member is
   obliged to bring it to the notice of the Presiding Officer immediately about the
   information of receipt of the complaint.

5. ICC shall on receipt of Complaint, shall proceed to make an inquiry on the complaint. A
  quorum of at least 3 Members is required to be present for the proceedings to take
  place. The quorum shall include the Presiding Officer and at least two members, one
  of whom shall be a woman.

6. Once the complaint is received by the ICC, the Respondent shall be served with a
  copy of the complaint within 7 working days from receipt of complaint. It should also
  be made clear that no act of retaliation or unethical action by the Respondent shall be
  tolerated and that the Respondent should extend full support during the investigation
  of the case. The Respondent shall file his reply to the complaint along with the
  supporting documents, names and addresses of the witnesses within 10 working
  days from the date of receipt of the documents from the ICC.

7. The Complainant, Respondent, and the employees named as witnesses are bound to
  appear before the ICC as and when called for during the hearings and shall always be
  under oath. The complaint shall be decided ex-parte by the ICC if the Complainant or
  the Respondent does not appear for 3 consecutive hearings.



                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 82
 8. Both the Complainant and the Respondent will be questioned separately by the ICC
    with a view to ascertain the authenticity of their contentions. Witnesses named if any,
    shall also be questioned separately.

 9. The parties to the complaint are not allowed to bring any legal practitioner to
   represent them in their case in any stage of the proceedings.

10. ICC shall ensure that a fair and just investigation is undertaken immediately and shall
   ensure that the inquiry into the complaint shall be completed within 90 days of the
   date of complaint. ICC may take any action as may be necessary to grant any interim
   relief to the Complainant.

11. As an interim remedy, at the request of the Complainant, the ICC may recommend to
   transfer the Complainant or the Respondent to any other Workplace; or grant leave up
   to a period of 3 months; or restrain the Respondent from reporting on the work
   performance of the Complainant.


12. The Complainant and the Respondent shall be informed of the outcome of the
    investigation. If the investigation reveals that the Complainant has been sexually
    harassed as claimed, the Respondent will be disciplined accordingly. Disciplinary
    action may result in any of the following:


       formal written apology
       suspension from services;
       transfer;
       withholding promotion;
       termination; and/or
       police complaint.


13. In case the complaint is found to be false, the Complainant shall, if deemed fit, be liable
    for appropriate disciplinary action by the ICC and the Company which may include all
   of the actions mentioned hereinabove. The final decision shall be communicated to
   the Complainant and the Respondent.




                                 Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   83
Points To Be Considered While Filing the Complaint:
1. The ICC is not bound to accept oral complaints under this Policy and all the complaints
  need to be in writing.

2. The Complainant and the Respondent shall disclose the details of all witnesses
  clearly and sufficient enough to enable the ICC to take action and call for the hearings.

3. Any complaint filed without disclosing the name of the Complainant and the
  Respondent cannot be taken into consideration.

4. Company always promotes timely reporting of incidents. However, the ICC may
  accept delayed complaints in case the Complainant has a valid and sufficient cause
  for delay.


5. Both the Complainant and the Respondent shall be given equal opportunity of being
   heard during the course of inquiry and copy of the findings of the ICC shall be served
   to both parties.



Inquiry Process and Recommendations:
1. The ICC shall have the powers of the civil court in deciding the complaint.

2. Upon completion of the inquiry process, the ICC shall submit an inquiry report of its
  findings to Company with a copy being served to Complainant and the Respondent.
  The Company shall also send its recommendation on the action pursuant to its
  inquiry.

3. If the ICC arrives at the conclusion that the complaint against the Respondent is
  proved, either through the course of the inquiry or through self-admission by the
  Respondent, the ICC shall make recommendation to Company to take action against
  the Respondent for misconduct, which action may be as under 9.2.11
  Company shall then act upon the recommendation of the ICC within 60 days from the
  receipt of such recommendation from ICC.

4. Company shall fully cooperate with officials such as police, if necessary, in case of
  complaint filed by the Complainant.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 84
Appeal:
Any person aggrieved under the inquiry process may prefer an appeal to the
tribunal/appellate authority under the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act,
1946.


Confidentiality:
1. The Company understands that it is difficult for the Complainant to come forward with
  a complaint of Sexual Harassment and recognizes the Complainant’s interest in
  keeping the matter confidential. To protect the interests of the Complainant, the
  Respondent and other witnesses, confidentiality will be maintained throughout any
  investigatory process to the extent practicable and appropriate under the
  circumstances.

2. The following information are considered confidential (“Confidential Information”):
      Contents of the complaint
      Identity and addresses of the Complainant, Respondent and witnesses
      Information relating to conciliation or inquiry proceedings
      Recommendations of the ICC
      Action taken by the Company


3. Every individual in the Company including the Complainant, Respondent, witnesses
   and the ICC, have an obligation to keep the Confidential Information as confidential
  and shall not publish, communicate to the public, press or media in any manner.


4. Any person who contravenes the confidentiality obligation shall be liable for penalty of
   up to Rupees Five Thousand for such contravention.




Access to Reports & Documents
All records of complaints, including contents of meetings, results of investigations and
other relevant material will be kept confidential by the Company except where
disclosure is required under disciplinary or other judicial processes.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 85
Protection to concerned parties
The Company is committed to ensuring that no Complainant who brings forward a
Sexual Harassment complaint is subject to any form of reprisal. Any reprisal will be
subject to disciplinary action. The Company will ensure that Complainants, Respondent
or witnesses are not victimized or discriminated against while dealing with complaints of
Sexual Harassment. However, anyone who abuses the procedure (for example, by
maliciously putting an allegation knowing it to be untrue) will be subject to strict
disciplinary action as further enumerated below.


Complaints Made with A Malicious Intent
1. This Policy has been evolved as a tool to ensure that in the interest of justice and fair
   play, the Company’s employees have a forum to approach in the event of instances of
   Sexual Harassment. However, if on investigation it is revealed that the complaint was
   made with a malicious intent and with the motive of maligning the concerned
   individual / tarnishing Respondent’s image in the Company and to settle
   personal/professional scores, or that any employee has given false evidence in
   support of the such cases, strict action will be taken against the Complainant.

2. If the ICC arrives at the conclusion that the complaint was filed falsely or maliciously or
  the evidence or document produced by the Complainant or the witnesses was forged
  or misleading, the action against such employee may include, withholding of
  promotion, pay rise or increments and go to the extent of terminating employment
  with the Company.

3. The malicious intent of the Complainant or the witnesses giving false evidence shall
  be established after conducting an inquiry into the matter.


Responsibility of Employees Regarding Sexual Harassment
All employees of the Company have a personal responsibility to ensure that their
behaviour is not contrary to this Policy. This Policy is deemed to be a part of the terms of
employment of every employee. All employees are encouraged to reinforce the
maintenance of a work environment free from Sexual Harassment.




                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   86
Policy Implementation & Review
The Policy will be implemented and reviewed by the Human Resources Department of
the Company. Any question or interpretation under this Policy will be handled by the
Human Resources Department of the Company.



Changes To Policy
The Company reserves the right to amend, abrogate, modify, and rescind/reinstate the
entire policy or any part of it at any given time. The changes to the Policy shall also be
pursuant to any amendment in the provisions of the Act from time to time. The
amended/modified policy shall be circulated to all the employees of the Company.



Dissemination of The Policy
A copy of this Policy shall be given to all employees and to all new recruits and they shall
sign a statement acknowledging that they have received, read, understood and will
abide by the Policy. The Company will take reasonable steps to ensure prevention of
Sexual Harassment at Workplace which may include awareness training to employees,
circulating applicable policies and other relevant information to all employees. The
Company shall carry out orientation programs to all new employees/joiners as well to
create awareness about the policy and its subject matter.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  87
25. GENDER NEUTRAL POLICY




OBJECTIVE
Lyzr AI India Private Limited understands that sexual harassment of employees at the
workplaceviolates the constitutional right to live with dignity, respect, and decency at the
workplace. The objectiveof this policy is to create and maintain a safe, secure and
enabling working environment for everyemployee, irrespective of gender (i.e.,
woman/man/third gender/non-binary), age or employment status,where all employees
treat each other with courtesy, dignity and respect without any discrimination
ongrounds of sexual orientation.


In furtherance of the above, the policy outlines the detailed procedures to be followed in
the event anemployee faces sexual harassment in the workplace




APPLICABILITY
This policy will extend to all employees of the Company, whether permanent or
temporary, probationary,part-time or working as a consultant or voluntarily or ad-hoc
basis, or engaged through a contractor oragent, whether for remuneration or not and
includes apprentice, trainee or intern, irrespective of thegender of the person
(“Employee”).



                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  88
IMPORTANT DEFINITIONS

a. “Aggrieved Person” means, in relation to a workplace, an Employee, of any age or
   gender, whoalleges to have been subjected to any act of sexual harassment by the
   Respondent”

b. “Respondent” means the Employee against whom the Aggrieved Person has made
     a complaint.

c.   “Sexual Harassment” would mean any or all of the following unwelcome acts or
     behaviour(directly or implied) which may occur within or outside the working hours,
     whether in or outsideof the Workplace, including but not limited to

     1. physical contact and advances
     2. a demand or request for sexual favours;
     3. making sexually coloured remarks;
     4. showing pornography;
     5. any other unwelcome physical, verbal, or non-verbal conduct of a sexual nature
     6. any act or conduct by a person in authority which creates the environment at the
        workplace,hostile or intimidating to an employee, such as the presence or
        occurrence of circumstances of

         implied or explicit promise of preferential treatment in employment;
         threat of detrimental treatment in employment;
         threat about present or future employment;
         interference with work or an offensive work environment;

     7. any other behaviour of a sexual nature that might reasonably be expected or be
        perceivedto cause offence or humiliation or humiliating treatment likely to affect
        the person’s healthor safety

d.    “Workplace” shall mean any premises, location, office(s), branch(es) or unit(s)
     established,owned and/or controlled by the Company, and shall also include a
     dwelling place or home of any employee, any place wherein work-related event or
     activity whether conducted inside or outsidethe office premises, during or after the
     office hours and includes any place visited by theEmployee arising out of or during
     the course of employment




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                89
REPORTING AND REDRESSAL PROCESS
The Head of Human Resources (HR) shall address all cases or complaints of alleged
sexualharassment submitted by any Aggrieved Person. An inquiry committee shall be
constituted involvingthe HR Head and 3 other Employees (“Committee”) to inquire into
and address such complaints. TheHead of HR shall head the Committee, and details of
the composition of such Committee shall becommunicated to employees.

The procedure to make complaints and the redressal process is as follows


a. The Aggrieved Person may file a written complaint of sexual harassment with the
   Committee eitherelectronically at shalini@lyzr.ai or by submitting a physical copy,
   including their name and detailsof any witnesses, supporting documents and shall
   contain sufficient information to enable theCommittee to initiate appropriate action

b.    The complaint shall be filed within 3 months from the date of the incident. However,
     the Committeemay accept a complaint filed beyond this period if the Aggrieved
     Person demonstrates valid andsufficient cause for the delay

c.    The Respondent shall file the reply to the complaint along with the supporting
     documents, namesand addresses of the witnesses, if any, within 7 working days
     from the date of receipt of thedocuments from the Committee

d.    The Aggrieved Person, Respondent and the Employees named as witnesses are
     bound to appearbefore the Committee as and when called for during the hearings.
     The case shall be decided exparte by the Committee if the Aggrieved Person or the
     Respondent do not appear for 3 consecutivehearings without sufficient cause.

e.    The parties of the complaint are not allowed to bring any legal practitioner to
     represent them intheir case at any stage of the proceedings

f.    The Committee may, during the pendency of the inquiry, grant such interim relief to
     the AggrievedPerson as it deems appropriate, based on the nature of the complaint
     and the circumstances ofthe case

g.    The inquiry into the complaint shall be completed within 90 days from the date of
     receipt of thecomplaint. Upon completion of the inquiry, the Committee shall prepare
     and submit its findings inthe form of an inquiry report. A copy of the inquiry report
     shall be shared with the Aggrieved Person,the Respondent, and the HR Department.
     The HR Department, in consultation with the Company,shall take appropriate action
     based on the recommendations of the Committee within 10 days fromthe date of
     receipt of the report



                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                90
h. If the Committee arrives at a conclusion that the complaint against the Respondent is
   proved,either through the course of the inquiry or through self-admission by the
   Respondent, theCommittee shall make a recommendation to the Company to take
   action against the Respondentfor misconduct, which action may also include the
   following

     1. To deduct such amounts from the salary of the Respondent as it may consider
        appropriate andbe paid to the Aggrieved Person or to his/her legal heirs;
     2. To withhold the promotion or pay rise, or increment to the Respondent;
     3. Terminate the Respondent from the employment/services.
     4. such other action that the Committee deems fit

i.   The Parties may, at any stage of the inquiry and with the consent of the Aggrieved
     Person, mutuallysettle the matter. Any such settlement shall be duly recorded in
     writing, and a copy thereof shallbe submitted to the Committee for appropriate
     closure of the complaint.



ASSISTANCE FOR AGGRIEVED PERSON
TO MAKE THE COMPLAINT
The Committee shall render all reasonable assistance to the Aggrieved Person for
reducing thecomplaint in writing in case the complaint cannot be made in writing by the
Aggrieved Person. In theevent the Aggrieved Person is unable to make a complaint on
account of physical or mental incapacity,death, or any other valid reason, a relative,
friend, co-worker, or any person having knowledge of theincident may file a complaint
on behalf of the Aggrieved Person.




FALSE AND MALICIOUS COMPLAINTS OR FALSE EVIDENCE
a. the Company shall take strict action against the complaints filed falsely or
   maliciously by anyEmployee who either files the complaint or gives false evidence in
     support of such cases.

a. the Committee arrives at a conclusion that the complaint was filed falsely or
   maliciously, or theevidence or document produced was forged or misleading, the
     action against such Employeesmay include withholding of promotion, pay rise or
     increments and go to the extent of terminatingthe employment with the Company.



                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              91
c. the malicious intent of the Employee as indicated above shall be established after
   conducting aninquiry into the matter.


CONFIDENTIALITY
All complaints, statements, and information related to cases of sexual harassment shall
be treated asstrictly confidential. The identity of the Aggrieved Person, the Respondent,
witnesses, and details ofthe proceedings shall not be disclosed to anyone not directly
involved in the process, except as requiredby law or for the purpose of investigation and
resolution of the complaint.


POLICY IMPLEMENTATION & REVIEW
The Policy will be implemented and reviewed by the Human Resources Department of
the Company.The Company reserves the right to amend, abrogate, modify, and
rescind/reinstate the entire policy orany part of it at any given time and provide notice of
such changes to the employees. Any question orinterpretation under this Policy will be
handled by the Human Resources Department of the Company.


CHANGES TO POLICY
Any changes to the policy pursuant to the amendment in the provisions of the Act shall
be incorporatedin this policy from time to time. The amended/modified Policy shall be
circulated to all the employeesof the Company.

26. Equal Employment Opportunity




Lyzr is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer (EEO) and the policy of EEO and anti-
discrimination applies to all aspects of the relationship between the Company and its
Employees, including Recruitment, Employment, Promotion, Transfer, Training, Working
Conditions, Wages and Salary administration, Employee benefits and application of
policies.


Managers are responsible for implementing equal employment practices within each
department. The HR department is responsible for overall compliance and will maintain
personnel records. Any discrimination is unwelcome that is based on race, colour,
religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national
origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status.


Violations of this policy will not be tolerated. The Company will promptly, thoroughly and
fairly investigate every issue that is brought to its attention in this area and will take
disciplinary action, when appropriate, up to and including termination of employment.

Any disputes arising from this Employee Playbook, including the appointment letter, shall
be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts located in the city of Lyzr’s Head Office,
regardless of the employee’s state or country of residence.
